purpose: Generate a source-derived complete V9 eye-closing action as five explicitly paired stages, so the full eye body and its familiar reflections visibly close and reopen instead of swapping isolated lid shapes.

rejected_attempts.reason: Generated as five paired stages rather than the requested eight equal single-eye cells; retained as inactive evidence.

locked_v9_reference.use: sole image reference for the complete V9 eye group: black oval, primary white reflection and tiny white sparkle

reference_policy: Only the locked V9 source may guide image generation. Rejected blink attempts are not references.

eye_group_contract.complete_group: Each open/closing/opening component is a complete single V9 eye group containing the black eye body plus its familiar white primary reflection and tiny white sparkle; closed is the complete closed-eye mark with no detached highlight
eye_group_contract.closing: same V9 eye identity visibly compresses in height while the reflection and sparkle remain attached inside the body; do not replace it with an isolated eyelid or cap
eye_group_contract.opening: same V9 eye identity visibly re-expands from the closed mark, with reflection and sparkle returning inside the black body before the base open eye resumes
eye_group_contract.pairing: left/right matched mirrored groups on the V9 anchors

native_review_gate.threshold: 1bpp black/white with white reflection holes preserved in the source mask
native_review_gate.pair_matching: each left/right group pair has equal height, width delta <=2 pixels and relative black-ink delta <=5% after normalization; preserve the V9 upper-left reflection grammar rather than mirroring the highlight
native_review_gate.stage_order: closing group has visibly more eye-body mass than closed and less height than open; opening is between closed and open
native_review_gate.manual_visual_triage: reject face art, isolated eyelid marks, caps, changed eye identity, missing reflection/sparkle in open/closing/opening groups, lashes, winks, sleep eyes, text, labels, grid, border or device frame
